digest.component_or_area: LLM runtime provider seam (runner.py, providers.py, anthropic_model.py, bedrock_model.py, structured.py)
propositions: rebar's LLM runtime branches on provider name strings (e.g., anthropic prefix matching) rather than using pydantic-ai's provider_factory extension point, creating hardcoded Anthropic-shaped behavior for prompt caching, output mode selection, and transport configuration
Documentation claims REBAR_LLM_BASE_URL and REBAR_LLM_API_KEY work with config.py parsing them, but runner.py:653 _pai_check_config refuses them outright, causing false documentation

AWS Bedrock is production-critical for clients but rebar has no native Bedrock path; PR#121's OpenAI-gateway approach silently loses prompt caching, retrying transport, read timeout, native structured output, and correct model provenance in signed verdicts

Signed verdict sidecars record only a model string, not structured provenance (provider, endpoint host, tier, capabilities), making it impossible for consumers to distinguish first-class from best-effort completions

Bedrock retry and timeout configuration do not reach botocore (BedrockProvider receives bare region_name only, no botocore.config.Config), leaving the production-live path unconfigured while timeout_s and llm_retry_max_attempts only affect direct-Anthropic

pydantic-ai exposes ModelProfile.supports_json_schema_output and per-vendor capability flags that differ between Bedrock-hosted Anthropic and direct Anthropic API, but rebar's output-mode selection ignores them and uses hardcoded _NATIVE_OUTPUT_PROVIDERS name matching instead
